It will be a bit shorter than a normal season and I will be putting out weekly updates during it to get features out and tested, some of these might be significant changes to some underlying system  - hence while we don't want to run a normal full on Season.

notes.title: Event System Update
notes.notes:
The patch is a bit larger than normal, even though this disk size should remain about the same.  I updated the engine to the latest version, so we didn't fall too far behind.  I did my best to test the change a lot before pushing this build out, but please let me know if you see anything off!

[h2]- Event System update. 
[/h2]
The old event system was pretty rigid, making it really hard to expand upon.  I've rewritten the entire system to allow for more dynamic chat events.   I've also added in a probability table, so it's more RNG when you use Bits / Tokens / Quarters to fire off events in chat. 

There's only a couple more events right now, but I'll be adding more over the next few builds as the system makes very easy to do so now.     

You can cheer 10+ bits in chat to trigger an event.  The higher the amount (up to 500) will trigger different tier events.  Over 500 will trigger the highest tier events only.   I'll try and get all the spells updated in the wiki in the next week... 

[h3]--  Streamer Spells --[/h3]

The next iteration on the streamer spells loadout is out, I think this is the direction I'm going to go wtih it.  I honestly just wasn't happy with the directions I've gone with it so far.  Later down the road we'll have a full loadout page as you'll be able to earn and slot more spells.  

There was also a major bug with the streamer spells where I don't think certain characters were being affected by some spells and at the very least the amount of damage they should have been doing, they weren't doing.   I've updated the way the spells work and will keep an eye on them. 

[h2]POQ[/h2]

Stream Arenas is now live on https://www.poq.gg/  I highly suggest checking out there platform, I think it's a pretty cool idea!   The backbones of integration with their system is in and soon you'll be able to use quarters to cause spells and the like in the game; with your quarters going to the Streamers as well.  (another way to support the streamers!)

[h3]BUGS[/h3]
- I knocked out a decent little list of bugs - there's still a lot and I'm working on prioritizing them for this next spring.

I plan on 1 more client release for this Season (though, possibly a content release as well)  and more work on the mobile apps.

notes.title: Arena Master Update
notes.notes:
[h1]The Arena Master is back! [/h1]


You now have a selection of spells that you can use in the Arena (with more to come!).  There are 2 different types of spells that you can spawn in the arena, with a variety of elemental damage. 

[b]Persistent Damage Spells:[/b]
These spells will remain for the entirety of the match, while they may not do a lot of initial damage, their persistent nature makes the arena a lot more hazardous! 


[b]Non-Persistent Spells.[/b]
These spell have a higher out put of damage and are good for securing kills as an Arena Master, these are spawned above the player and have an AOE type damage or some that do high damage and spawn directly on a player. 


Each spell has it's own cooldown, damage, and elemental type.  Elemental Type doesn't play anything in the game at the moment, but later players can get resistance to certain elemental types and you'll be able to level up your Arena Master and unlock multiple types of elemental damage for each spell.

[b]You can find out more about spells on the [url=http://wiki.streamarenas.com/doku.php?id=arena_master]wiki[/url].[/b]


Beast and Bosses will remain automatically spawning.  But, you'll get one Boss per match that will scale better based on the amount of players in the arena.   

You can set up your up your loadout right in the Lobby, so you can change things between matches.

notes.title: Season 3 update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to Season 3! [/h1]

Season 2 was [b]too long![/b]  We can all agree on that, whew.. sweaty.    Season's from now on will be set at a 4week 3 day cadence, optimal pummeling time.    Why 3 days?  Want to kick off the season on Community day and let people have a chance to score some drops right out the door and end on a Sunday for that weekend optimal leaderboard chase.

[h1]Season 3 Kickoff Tournament / Event[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38506942/713f763c2c19ac9ead9915954fa294b6f2b1c8d5.png[/img]

[h1]What's new in Season 3?[/h1]

[b]New Ranking system for Leaderboards. [/b]

There's 9 internal rankings for the Leaderboards, you can think of these as like Tier Rankings.   This allows us to make different segments of the leaderboards more competitive by offering bonuses for killing people X tiers above you. 

So as of now you'll receive bonus points for killing people that are 3+ tiers ahead of you, the scoring is set in away that we should basically have 3 different competitive section on the leaderboards (dependent on amount of players of course). 

The simple way to look at this.     If you're in Tier 3 and kill someone on in Tier 6, you'll gain 2 extra bonus points on the leaderboards. 


[b]Arena Powers Revamp V1[/b]

The Arena Powers were fun for season 2, but they were also a bit awkward.   The inconsistent beasts, bosses depending on where you were playing weren't the best - and though 'auto strimmer' tried, it just didn't make the best of the powers.  Not too mention the 'Helping Lightening' could feel a bit bad if a streamer just tried to decimate the players with it (though, super fun as the streamer at times).  

With that I've removed the control for the powers ([b]BITS still work!![/b]) and the powers will just automagically / randomly occur.  Beasts and bosses will now spawn based on time + amount of people alive. More people? More beasts. 

[b]Brand new Arena Pass[/b]

I love the idea of having a pass that you can earn free goodies in the game; it makes it fun!  But, I also think just straight XP pass is a bit 'drab'.   The pass has been reworked to reward you for achieving different stats during the season, this is the first version towards trying to build out a more 'quest like' reward system through future season (probably a ways off, lots of work to do everywhere!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38506942/2e9b4fbc9a4c246873a1be5336031ccfd1d035d7.png[/img]

[b]Banners and Titles[/b]

You can now earn Banners and Titles through completing quests!  We'll come up with more ways to reward these as the seasons go on.  

Banners will be placed next to you when you win a match.   Titles will be shown below your name in game, you'll be able to equip these in your loadout on steam/Mobile.

[b]More Stuff[/b]
There was a long list of bug changes and just general improvements.   There will be new characters, maps, and more through the season!  Working on a better cadence for releases (rather than just all the time!) to keep some content fresh for the following seasons and to also give myself a break here and there. 

I have lots of plans for the Game and plan on keeping it rolling!   Hope to see you in the arena!

Every Friday there will be an Arena Pass XP gain setup.   This means that any stream that you're playing in will get you more XP in your Arena pass to unlock free goodies! 

[b]Auto Powers[/b]
If you don't want to use the full 'Auto Streamer Mode' to have the camera follow people about, but like the option of Auto Powers, you can now toggle Auto Powers on during a match with 'P'

[b]Scoring Changes[/b]
Some changes to the way that scoring works in match to lessen the spread of grinding.  Also, you're now awarded 'sacraficial points' when you're killed by an Arena Power

[b]Balance Pass[/b]
A balance pass to help bring the older characters into more competition with the new characters, they're much more competitive now. 

Improvements
[list]
[*]  You can now change the speed of the camera during the match rather than waiting for it to update between matches.
[*]  You can now update lobby positioning (webcam placement) while you're on the Lobby Page.
[*]  Escape now properly brings up the menu, locks the camera, and frees your mouse.
[*]  TAB does the same as ESC without bringing up the Menu
[*]  Auto Fight Mode - Adjusted (lowered) the percentage chance on each check for auto ults | beast targeting. 
[/list]

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*]  Twitch IRC disconnect issue fix, we now retry if we lose connection. 
[*]  Fixed an issue where Local Leaderboards weren't scrollable 
[*]  Typo / Text cleanup on new help menu
[*]  Fixed an issue with resizing the window resetting to screen resolution when reloading a level
[*]  Fixed a bug where you had to hit 'esc' twice to bring up the menu in-game
[*]  Clicking 'Resume' on the in-game menu will now set your mouse back to locked 

[/list]

notes.title: Release .86 is live
notes.notes:
[b]Machu Picchu is Live[/b]! 
Jump in the new Temple themed arena and be crowned the top archeologist ... er Chatiator! 

[b] AI Collision Updates [/b]

 Made changes to the way that AI collision behave, rather than keeping the complete removal of collision on players, I've added it back with a much lower radius than before.  I've also kept the avoidance low, meaning that while Chatiators / beasts / bosses will now go back to colliding with each other, the radius in which they do is significantly smaller.   

This will help with completely stacking on top of each other and hopefully still maintain the ability to have the smaller pathways and stairs not bottle neck.  


[b] Auto Streamer Mode [/b]

This was release last build, but I left it out of patch notes to work on a few issues that I was seeing with it. This still needs some TLC, but you can use it! 

Hitting 'Z" while in an arena will Toggle 'auto mode' which means that game will follow random character, switch focus, and randomly use abilities.   This can be really nice if you're deep in conversation, have to jump up and use the restroom, etc. 

This is a toggle, so hitting Z will turn it on and off.   Plans to evolve this are still in the works for the future. 

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Multiple bug fixes

notes.title: Release .82
notes.notes:
introducing [b]Overwhelmed[/b]:

Overwhelmed is an automatic flee mechanic that is implemented to help with everyone targeting and burning down the same person.   If you take damage from 3 or more different targets in quick succession you will flee from the fight.


Introducing [b]Keep it Ten[/b]

Keep it Ten will allow matches that have the minimum requirements (3) Chatiators in the match to fill with bots to 10  players.  This allows for matches to be a bit more exciting and with the AutoHelper for bots and players to kill beasts along the way.  You can toggle this feature on and off in the Settings menu.

- Fleeing will not drop your current targets
- You can change Settings in Game - Hit Escape twice to bring up the menu. 
-  You can now set the In-Game leaderboards up to fit your layout (with scale and all)
- Multiple Bug Fixes.

notes.title: Release .81
notes.notes:
[b] Auto Mode
[/b]      This was a big departure from the current state of the game that basically 'enforced' the concept of having to be active in the Arena to have the best chance.   While I still believe being active will give you the biggest run for your money, you'll make a more interesting combatant if you're lurking and playing! 

Auto Mode will make your champion will give your champion a chance to ult / attack beasts.  There is a percentage of chance on each check, so it wont be automatic. 

Auto mode is turned off as soon as you use any sort of command during the match. 

- Added a New Prompt so that I can easily inform people of updates/changes that might be important. 
- Fixed up some event listeners for bots for future stuff
- Collecting dmg stats from rounds
- Changed the End Game Leaderboards a bit to show Last Person Standing / Most Dmg / Most Kills
